Not too long after the fuzzy tape which you just heard (inaudible) had a setback which sent him to the hospital in Middletown, New York. Twice he was released, only to be readmitted almost immediately in a period of several weeks. He came out just two days before the Community Birthday Party which we had planned for him.

I visited him in the hospital the two days before -- several times but the two days before -- and I saw he had written something on a piece of paper which said, "The secret of tomorrow is to try to make it there."

In the fall he went back to New York to stay, but almost immediately wound up in the New York Infirmary, where he is now. I've made several attempts to tape him. We finally agreed that we would do it via the telephone, and this is what the following tapes reflect.
